items.briefing:
Quest Apartment Hotels has confirmed a customer data breach linked to a vulnerability in a third-party system, serving as a timely reminder that your personal data can be exposed even when the organisation you deal with directly has done nothing wrong. Australian businesses should also be aware that internal fraud remains a significant blind spot, particularly for merchants — staff with access to financial systems pose a real risk that is often overlooked.

A separate warning highlights that improperly redacted documents can still expose sensitive information if the underlying text isn't fully removed. **Practical tip:** Before sharing any PDF or Word document externally, use your software's built-in redaction tools properly — simply drawing a black box over text is not enough.
